Growth & demand: Indian tea exports also increased by approximately 10% to 280 million kgs on increased demand from markets such as the UAE, Iraq and China, notwithstanding the volatility arising from the conflicts in the Middle East and the Ukraine-Russia region.
The turnover increased from ` 177.35 crores to ` 220.69 crores, representing a growth of 25%, primarily driven by higher production following the acquisition of Dhoedaam.

Adequate number of capacitors were pro vided for maintaining power factor for financial reward of 3% rebate on electricity bills. - Hydraulic testing of the gas supply pipeline was conducted for all estates receiving gas.
Margins & costs: Bought leaf sourcing was marginally lower at 4.37 lakh kgs as against 4.91 lakh kgs in the previous year.

Cost Audit Pursuant to Section 148 of the Act read with Rule 4 of the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules, 2014, your Company is required to have the audit of its cost accounting records relating to products manufactured by the Company.
The Operating Profit before depreciation and interest (EBITDA) of the Company for the year was ` 2,971.28 lakhs as against ` 2,970.68 lakhs in the previous year.
